selection.eligibility: at least 100 observed logs matching eight EVM selector signatures
selection.event_rank: descending matched logs, then ascending block number, transaction index and hash
selection.pool_rank: descending distinct emitter/(emitter and topic1 pool ID for V4 and Balancer) keys, then ascending block number, transaction index and hash
selection.selection: first choose event rank, then highest pool rank from eligible distinct transactions; exclude previously deep-audited transaction identities
